events.title: Mac users can pluck too!
events.summary: Good news, Mac players — Pluck Em! now supports macOS.The new Mac version comes as a universal build, so it works on both newer Apple Silicon machines and older Intel-based Macs. Just download the game through Steam and start plucking. So, what does Pluck Em! bring to the table? Plenty of good stuff:🦆 11 unique biomes to hunt across.🔫 A growing arsenal of weapons, gadgets, and upgrades.📈 Roguelite progression that unlocks new possibilities with every run.🏅 Leaderboards to chase your best score.📖

events.title: Night Vision and Exploding Ducks Are Here
events.summary: We just added Night Vision Goggles and exploding birds to Pluck Em!The goggles help you spot targets after dark, while explosive birds turn one clean shot into a chain reaction of feathers, fire, and very bad news for anything flying nearby.Night hunting just got a lot easier. For you, at least.

events.title: How It Started: Building Pluck Em with Moonlake AI
events.summary: Hello World!I think it's worth sharing how this all started.At first, it was just an experiment.
